tooltip.jaymospowers.tinkering.smithing_: Lay hot ingots on it, then strike with a smithing hammer. Sneak-use a hammer on an anvil to make one.
tooltip.jaymospowers.hot_ingot: Lay it on a Smithing Anvil before it cools. Carry it with tongs.
tooltip.jaymospowers.tongs: Hold in either hand to carry hot metal without burning.
tooltip.jaymospowers.smithing_hammer: Strike a Smithing Anvil in time with the bar. Sneak-use on an anvil to make it a Smithing Anvil.
screen.jaymospowers.forge.title: Forge
screen.jaymospowers.forge.sub: What will you hammer it into?
message.jaymospowers.smithing.burns: The hot metal burns your hands! Hold tongs.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.take_resul: Take the finished piece off the anvil first.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.empty: Lay hot metal on the anvil first.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.cold: The metal is too cold to work. Heat it on a forge hearth.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.went_cold: The metal on the anvil has gone cold.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.busy: Someone else is working this anvil.
message.jaymospowers.smithing.nothing: There's nothing you can forge from this much metal.
